description: Header file for 3D transformation functions in a Lua bindings context, defining functions for rotation, scaling, and translation operations.

methods.name: rotateX
methods.description: Rotate geometry around the X axis, taking a Lua state as parameter.

methods.name: rotateY
methods.description: Rotate geometry around the Y axis, taking a Lua state as parameter.

methods.name: rotateZ
methods.description: Rotate geometry around the Z axis, taking a Lua state as parameter.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotate geometry in 2D, taking a Lua state as parameter.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scale geometry uniformly or non-uniformly, taking a Lua state as parameter.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translate geometry in 3D space, taking a Lua state as parameter.
